name: District Merit Scholarship (Kerala, Plus One and Plus Two)
description: Merit award of the Directorate of Collegiate Education, Kerala, for students who got A+ in all subjects in SSLC and now study in a government or aided higher-secondary school in Kerala (Plus One and Plus Two). No family income limit. Apply online on the DCE scholarship portal. The yearly last date is announced by DCE; secondary sources mention 30 Nov 2026, which is NOT confirmed. Helpline 9446096580.
benefits: ₹1,250 a year during Plus One and Plus Two.
source_organization: Directorate of Collegiate Education (DCE), Government of Kerala
required_documents: SSLC marksheet showing A+ in all subjects
